source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the triple warning, harsh animal image and circumcision wordplay in a note.
key_decisions.before: Watch out for the dogs. Watch out for the evil workers. Watch out for those who mutilate the flesh.
key_decisions.after: Watch out for the dogs! Watch out for the evil workers! Watch out for those who mutilate the flesh!
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of those who mutilate the flesh.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the community claim and the three defining participles.
key_decisions.before: For we are the circumcision—we who worship by the Spirit of God, boast in Christ Jesus, and put no confidence in the flesh,
key_decisions.after: For we are the circumcision: we worship by God's Spirit, boast in Christ Jesus and put no confidence in the flesh,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For we are the circumcision, who worship by the Spirit of God and boast in Christ Jesus and put no confidence in the flesh—

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the flesh refrain and the comparative challenge.
key_decisions.before: though I myself have reasons for confidence even in the flesh. If anyone else thinks they have reasons for confidence in the flesh, I have more:
key_decisions.after: though I too have grounds for confidence in the flesh. If anyone else thinks they have such grounds, I have more:
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: though I myself have reason for confidence in the flesh. If anyone else thinks he has reason for confidence in the flesh, I have more:

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves every biographical marker and the eighth day.
key_decisions.before: circumcised on the eighth day, from the people of Israel, from the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
key_decisions.after: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew born of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew born of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps persecution explicit alongside the claim of legal blamelessness.
key_decisions.before: as to zeal, a persecutor of the church; as to righteousness under the law, blameless.
key_decisions.after: as to zeal, a persecutor of the church; as to righteousness under the law, blameless.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: as to zeal, a persecutor of the church; as to righteousness under the law, blameless.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the accounting reversal and plural gains to singular loss.
key_decisions.before: But whatever gains I had, I have come to regard these as loss because of Christ.
key_decisions.after: But whatever counted as gains for me, I have counted as loss because of Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But whatever gains I had, these I have come to regard as loss because of Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the intensifying everything and the offensive discard image with its range in a note.
key_decisions.before: More than that, I regard everything as loss because of the surpassing value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. Because of him I have lost all things, and I regard them as rubbish, so that I may gain Christ
key_decisions.after: More than that, I count everything as loss compared with the surpassing worth of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. For him I have lost everything, and I count it as refuse so that I may gain Christ
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: More than that, I regard everything as loss because of the surpassing value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. For his sake I have suffered the loss of all things, and I regard them as rubbish,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves both faith expressions and records the consequential alternative faith in Christ.
key_decisions.before: and be found in him—not having my own righteousness from the law, but the righteousness that comes through the faithfulness of Christ, the righteousness from God grounded in trust.
key_decisions.after: and be found in him, having no righteousness of my own from the law, but the righteousness that comes through Christ's faithfulness, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and be found in him—not with a righteousness of my own that comes from the law, but one that comes through trust in Christ, a righteousness from God grounded in trust.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains knowing, power, participation and conformity without making suffering disappear.
key_decisions.before: I want to know him—the power of his resurrection and the sharing of his sufferings—becoming conformed to his death,
key_decisions.after: I want to know him, the power of his resurrection and the sharing of his sufferings, being shaped into the likeness of his death,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I want to know Christ—and the power of his resurrection—and the sharing of his sufferings, becoming like him in his death,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the source's tentative reaching rather than supplying certainty.
key_decisions.before: if somehow I may attain the resurrection from the dead.
key_decisions.after: if somehow I may reach the resurrection from the dead.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: if somehow I may attain the resurrection from the dead.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the repeated grasping language and the incomplete attainment.
key_decisions.before: Not that I have already received this or have already been made complete, but I press on to take hold of it because Christ Jesus has taken hold of me.
key_decisions.after: Not that I have already obtained this or have already been made perfect. But I press on to take hold of it, because Christ has taken hold of me.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Not that I have already taken hold of this or have already been made complete, but I press on to make it my own, because Christ Jesus has made me his own.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the repeated denial and bodily reaching image.

key_decisions.after: Brothers and sisters, I do not consider that I have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: forgetting what lies behind and stretching toward what lies ahead,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Brothers and sisters, I do not consider that I have made it my own; but one thing I do: forgetting what lies behind and straining forward to what lies ahead,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves goal, prize and upward call without explaining the prize beyond the text.

key_decisions.after: I press on toward the goal, for the prize of God's upward call in Christ Jesus.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the mature/perfect word connection and room for differing thought.

key_decisions.after: Let all of us who are mature think this way. And if you think differently about anything, God will reveal that to you too.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let those of us who are mature think this way; and if in anything you think differently, God will make this clear to you also.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the short pinned reading without adding the longer rule or mindset clauses.

key_decisions.after: Only, let us keep in step with what we have already attained.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the accusation as the speaker's grief-laden statement.
key_decisions.before: For many live as enemies of the cross of Christ. I have often told you about them, and now I tell you even with tears.
key_decisions.after: For many live as enemies of Christ's cross. I have often told you about them, and now I tell you even with tears.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For many live as enemies of the cross of Christ; I have often told you of them, and now I tell you even with tears.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps all four claims and the bodily belly metaphor.

key_decisions.after: Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and their glory is in their shame. Their minds are set on earthly things.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Their end is destruction; their god is the belly; their glory is in their shame; their minds are set on earthly things.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves civic identity, waiting and the full title without adding escape imagery.
key_decisions.before: But our citizenship is in heaven, and from there we eagerly await a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.after: But our citizenship is in heaven, and from there we eagerly await a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But our citizenship is in heaven, and from there we await a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps bodily transformation and its relation to universal subjection.
key_decisions.before: He will transform our humiliated body to be conformed to his glorious body, by the power that enables him even to bring all things under his rule.
key_decisions.after: He will transform our lowly body to be like his glorious body, by the power that enables him to bring all things under his rule.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He will transform the body of our humiliation so that it may be conformed to the body of his glory, by the power that enables him to bring all things under his rule.
